_meta._pricing_tier_resolved_by: quality field — see resolve_pricing_tier rule below
_meta._invoice_status_note: Cost varies by quality tier. See recipes/image/invoice-status.json[gpt-image-2-low|medium|high|auto]. HIGH AND AUTO TIERS ARE UNVERIFIED ESTIMATES.

quality._note: EvoLink route exposes explicit low|medium|high quality. Do not expose auto in Media Console; it is blocked by the production validator to prevent surprise spend.

negative_prompt_policy._note: GPT Image 2 has no separate negative_prompt field. Express avoid-this in natural language inline. The model is robust to 'do not include X' phrasing.

reference_syntax._note: EvoLink gpt-image-2 accepts up to 16 image_urls.

official_prompt_template._ordering: natural-language descriptive prompt, no rigid structure required

validator_rules.throws: gpt-image-2: quality must be explicitly low|medium|high. 'auto' is only allowed when ctx.allow_auto_quality === true (prevents surprise spend on high tier).
